text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"varied sentence openings and linking phrases like 'So then,' 'For example,' and 'In conclusion,'","quality":"organizational control","description":"The essay shows a clearer overall progression of ideas with more deliberate transitions and paragraph-to-paragraph movement."},{"evidence":"specific school example and extended support for younger and older students","quality":"idea development","description":"The essay develops its point with more concrete examples and explanation rather than mostly repeating the same claim."},{"evidence":"fewer sentence fragments and more complete sentences","quality":"sentence control","description":"The writing has somewhat better command of sentence completeness and clause structure even though errors remain."},{"evidence":"more varied vocabulary such as 'clarify,' 'communication skills,' and 'strategy'","quality":"lexical range","description":"The essay uses a somewhat wider and more precise set of words to express its ideas."},{"evidence":"mostly consistent line of reasoning about benefits for both age groups","quality":"coherence","description":"The essay stays more focused on one central argument and keeps its points connected more consistently."}]}
